_meta.what: Names a monster used to be filed under here, kept searchable after it was renamed.
_meta.why: Every rename in scripts/fix-monster-names.mjs replaced a name that our table really carried, and search matches whole words against the current name only. 'Pecopeco' no longer finds Peco Peco; 'Wootan Fighter' no longer finds Utan Fighter. Some of these are typos nobody would type, but the rest are the older or shorter form a long-time player still uses, and dropping them would trade one search miss for another.
_meta.rule: Only a name this table actually held, with the date it was replaced. Not a guess at what someone might call the monster -- that is what data/aliases-th.json records, and it needs a real search behind it.
